description: Amphistar is transforming the surfactant industry with high-purity biosurfactants derived from second generation (2G) feedstocks, reducing reliance on fossil-based chemicals.
Aphea.Bio is a leading player in the development of the next-generation of agricultural biological products based on naturally occurring microorganisms.
Biosyntia is an industrial biotech company delivering nature’s ingredients at scale both affordably and sustainably.

Doktar is a leading digital agriculture company providing AI-driven tools that help farmers optimize crop management, reduce input use and improve resilience against climate and market volatility. By integrating satellite imagery, IoT sensors and proprietary machine-learning models into an intuitive decision-support platform, Doktar delivers field-level insights that enable more precise fertilization, irrigation and plant health monitoring.

ecoat is a pioneering green chemistry company developing bio-based and hybrid polymer technologies that drastically reduce the environmental footprint of paints and coatings. By designing high-performance binders derived from renewable plant-based resources, ecoat enables manufacturers to transition away from fossil-based polymers without compromising durability, functionality or application properties.
Ecorobotix is a pioneering agtech company transforming crop protection through ultra-precision spraying technology that drastically reduces the use of herbicides, pesticides and liquid fertilizers.
Elicit Plant is a biotechnology company addressing the physiological resilience of crops through natural, high-performance solutions tailored to agricultural practices.

Foodforecast is a climate-tech company leveraging artificial intelligence to reduce food waste and optimize operational efficiency across the food and ultra-fresh food segment. Through its predictive analytics platform, Foodforecast enables businesses to accurately forecast demand, streamline production planning and minimize surplus, addressing one of the most pressing sustainability challenges in the global food system.
Heura is redefining the plant-based food industry with a mission-driven approach to clean-label, additive-free and nutritionally superior alternatives to meat and dairy.

Nofence is the world’s first virtual fencing company, pioneering a transformative approach to sustainable livestock management through GPS, IoT and animal-centric behavioural technology. By replacing traditional physical fences with a digital, app-controlled system, Nofence enables farmers to guide livestock grazing with unprecedented precision from anywhere at any time.
Nuritas is revolutionizing the discovery of novel, natural and scientifically proven bioactive peptide ingredients with the aim of helping companies innovate towards healthier accessible products.

OroraTech is a global intelligence-as-a-service company leveraging thermal data for a sustainable Earth. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, OroraTech operates in North America, South America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.

Packmatic is a digital procurement platform transforming how companies source flexible packaging by connecting brands directly with a curated network of verified manufacturers. Through a data-driven, fully transparent marketplace, Packmatic reduces the complexity, cost and environmental footprint of packaging procurement while increasing speed, quality and supply-chain resilience.
Paptic develops and manufacturers sustainable and circular materials to replace fossil-based plastic films in flexible packaging.
Protix is the leading company in insect-based ingredients for healthy and sustainable pet food, animal feed and organic fertilizer.
RED Horticulture (“RED”) is an IoT-based LED lighting solutions provider to greenhouse growers worldwide.
REDUCED is pioneering a new wave of clean-label, natural and sustainable food ingredients.

SQIM is a pioneering material innovation company developing life-driven technologies with a scalable industrial mindset. By collaborating with Nature rather than extracting from it, SQIM creates solutions that generate long-term value for the planet, people, and industry.
Trapview, developed by EFOS, is a game-changing solution that efficiently powers the plant protection decision-making process.

VEGDOG is a pioneering pet food company developing 100% plant-based, veterinary-formulated dog nutrition that combines environmental responsibility with optimal animal health. Founded to challenge the resource-intensive nature of traditional meat-based pet diets, VEGDOG creates complete and balanced recipes using high-quality plant proteins and carefully selected functional ingredients that meet dogs’ full nutritional needs.

Wakuli is redefining the coffee industry through a radically transparent, direct-trade model that delivers higher incomes for farmers and high-quality, sustainably sourced coffee for consumers. By working directly with smallholder cooperatives and paying prices far above commodity market levels, Wakuli strengthens economic resilience in coffee-growing communities while ensuring long-term environmental stewardship across the supply chain.
Watttron is transforming industrial heating through digital precision technology, enabling higher efficiency, material savings, and sustainability in packaging and beyond.
Weenat is redefining agricultural water management with its precision irrigation technology and advanced agrometeorological solutions.
